Package: graft
Summary: local-first video composition workspace
URL: https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft
License: Apache-2.0

Description:
graft is a local-first composition workspace. The incremental compiler
is the build engine. Runtime ffmpeg is not linked; graft shells out.

Spec: https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft/blob/main/dist/rpm/graft.spec
Release: https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft/releases/tag/v0.2.2

This is a Fedora package review request covering Fedora, EPEL, and the
RHEL clones that follow Fedora (Rocky, Alma, CentOS Stream, Amazon,
EuroLinux, openEuler via the same spec family). openSUSE/Mageia/OpenMandriva
can reuse the spec after Fedora lands.

FAS account required to open:
https://bugzilla.redhat.com/enter_bug.cgi?product=Fedora&component=Package%20Review
